name: Dependencies
excerpt: Dependencies are logical relationships between project activities.
notes: Dependencies define the order of activities in a project. They can be mandatory, discretionary, external, or internal, and are categorized by type: Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Finish-to-Finish, and Start-to-Finish.
context_summary:
- Define logical relationships between project activities.
- Determine the order of activities.
- Can be mandatory, discretionary, external, or internal.
- Categorized by type: Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start, Finish-to-Finish, Start-to-Finish.
